headline: Trump Lawyers Warn That Kennedy Center Might Need Demolition if Not Fixed
context: In a court filing about honoring President Trump on the facade, the administration said that without a proper renovation the building might need to be “taken down.”

sources.summary: US president’s lawyers in court filing say Washington arts complex must undergo repairs or risk demolition The John F Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts could be demolished if repairs are not carried out, the Trump administration warned in a court filing on Monday. Lawyers for the US president said the national arts complex in Washington DC must undergo a $250m renovation or risk facing the wrecking ball. Continue reading...
